dataList.title:
The Hierarch of Hongyuan
鸿园的家主
dataList.place:
Daguanyuan Sparring Grounds
大观园 公认武斗对练场
dataList.content:
I heard from big bro that you sent your coins to ... big brother Qiu.
我从哥哥那里听说了。你把自己的铜钱……送给了丘哥哥。

Every hand, once in circulation, goes round and round until it eventually returns to their original owners.
每一张牌都会几经周转并最终物归原主。

I also heard that some of the Wang family helped with removing the foreign powers from here.
我听说王家也在赶出外部势力时献了一份力。
dataList.title:
The Hierarch of Hongyuan
鸿园的家主

dataList.content:
Why?
你当时在想什么？
dataList.title:
The Hierarch of Hongyuan
鸿园的家主

dataList.content:
I only wanted to prevent this place from getting robbed blind. I live here, you know. This is where my wealth lies.
我只是想阻止这里被洗劫一空。至少我得守住自己的财富。

Well, then... can I ask for your public support?
那么……就不能公开支持下我吗？
dataList.title:
The Hierarch of Hongyuan
鸿园的家主

dataList.content:
Oh. I applaud your audacity in thinking someone who just gave you the moon should be asked for the stars as well.
啊，你想掏空救命恩人的口袋是吗？

Everyone and their mother knows in whose hands the true political power of Hongyuan lies right now. With that in mind, let's say that I do announce my public support for you.
现如今鸿园的实权究竟在谁手中人尽皆知，如果我单独表态支持您的话……

I'm not going to have a voice to speak with by the time the powers that be are done with me.
那双权力的大手难道不会斩下我的舌头，让我再也说不了话吗？

dataList.title:
The Hierarch of Hongyuan
鸿园的家主

dataList.content:
Look, if big sis Yuanchun genuinely believes that...
如果元春姐姐想要把我推下台的理由是……
dataList.title:
The Hierarch of Hongyuan
鸿园的家主

dataList.content:
... I'm not fit to be the Family Hierarch, then I'll happily remove myself from power.
是我真的不具备成为家主的资格的话，那我将心甘情愿地就此成全她。
dataList.title:
The Hierarch of Hongyuan
鸿园的家主

dataList.content:
But she's affiliated with Q Corp. Do you seriously believe she has Hongyuan's best interests at heart with all those conspiracies she's been weaving under the surface, all those business deals and clearly skewed policies?
但姐姐现在是Q公司的人。你真的相信姐姐暗地里准备的那些事业与政策都是为了鸿园吗？
dataList.title:
The Hierarch of Hongyuan
鸿园的家主

dataList.content:
I do not.
我不信。

But if you’re going to present yourself as the alternative, then you have to be someone concrete enough to rely on.
但我眼前的家主看起来也不是牢固的靠山。

Let me just say that about half of the board of directors' votes may as well be considered abstaining votes.
其实董事会的票数中有一半是沉默票。

They're keeping their silence because they're afraid of Jia Yuanchun's retaliation.
他们害怕贾元春报复，只能默不作声假装听话。

So, your remaining task is to convert those silent votes... in your favor.
而让那些沉默的人们为你转身，便是日后你要做的事。

dataList.title:
The Hierarch of Hongyuan
鸿园的家主

dataList.content:
Ohh. Not shaken by that at all, huh.
哦吼。神情坚毅啊。

I thought you'd get that lost and wandering look in your eyes...
你的内心应该充满了迷茫才对……

Tsk, I guess I'll have to work on my poker face.
嘁……看来扑克脸还不够完美。
dataList.title:
The Hierarch of Hongyuan
鸿园的家主

dataList.content:
No, no. Most people would've failed to pick that up. You've certainly changed since the Evaluation.
不，大部分人应该都看不穿你。你的气场跟家主之争时不一样了。

Your growth shows a lot of promise. Maybe that's why he handed his coins over to you.
看来你成长得很快。所以那个人才会把铜钱交给你吧。

Well... I guess that's not the only thing he handed over to you, I suppose.
不对……他交给你的，恐怕不只是铜钱呢。

... Hongyuan's tomorrow...
鸿园的未来……
dataList.title:
The Hierarch of Hongyuan
鸿园的家主

dataList.content:
Anyways, I should probably do as I'm told for now, hm?
不过，我也得先公事公办了。

My cousin'll be your opponent today.
你的对手是我的堂妹。

... I won't accept you as my Hierarch just yet.
……我还无法认你为家主。

Fight me, and prove that you're at least better than I am. Only then I'll accept you.
至少要决一胜负……证明你更优秀，我才能认可你。
